_: FitLog v1.7.0 -- rings use the last goals the Watch sent. 01-05 fail on the previous build (grey rings, 'no goal on file'). 06 and 07 guard behaviour the previous build already had: 06 is shown failing by inventing a goal when none was ever sent; 07 by making a goal rule-bearing inside the health_ingest.py sidecar.

assertions.name: 01 today's strip fills against the last goals the Watch sent
02 a carried-forward goal is always named with its date
03 the /watch rings fill; Move falls back to active energy
04 the newest goal on or before the day is used
05 a goal sent today wins over an older one
06 with no goal ever sent, nothing is invented

mutation.why: a default goal is invented when the Watch never sent one
mutation.replace: out[k] = (r["value"], r["date"]) if r else (300, day)
